name: Palestinian Chicken Musakhan with Sumac Onions and Flatbread

components.name: Roast Sumac Chicken

ingredients.name: Raw bone-in chicken legs, skin on

steps: Season chicken with salt, sumac and seven-spice, coat in oil and arrange on a lined tray.
Roast at 205 C for roughly 40-50 minutes until the thickest meat reaches 74 C.
For meal prep, store chicken and onion mixture together and wrap bread separately. Do not store an assembled bread base for several days.

components.name: Flatbread with Sumac Onions & Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: Plain Arabic flatbread or taboon bread

steps: Meanwhile, slowly sauté the sliced onions with olive oil over medium-low heat until softened and lightly caramelized; season with sumac, seven-spice and salt.
Lightly toast the pine nuts separately, watching closely so they do not burn.
For immediate eating, warm the flatbread briefly, spread with onions, then add chicken, pine nuts, lemon and parsley.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source-style musakhan converted into separately packed components to prevent soggy bread. Original source includes a brief final broil when assembling fresh.
Planning: Secondary stovetop for slow-cooked onions and pine nuts.
Freezer: for chicken and onions; bread should be frozen or stored separately
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
